title: ARMORY CASTLE exploits vCenter zero-day CVE-2026-123890 as Mandiant and Google Threat Intelligence publish further activity details
content_md:
ARMORY CASTLE is exploiting the vCenter zero-day CVE-2026-123890. Mandiant and the Google Threat Intelligence Group have published further details on the group's activity.

via Mastodon https://www.all-about-security.de/armory-castle-nutzt-vcenter-zero-day-cve-2026-123890-aus/
